campus_results_too_many.why: The campus pack results upload refuses more result files than one upload may carry; the user uploads the pack's results in a smaller set.

campus_result_too_large.why: The campus pack results upload refuses a result file over the per-file cap; the user uploads a shorter recording of that case.

campus_results_too_large.why: The campus pack results upload refuses result files over the total cap together; the user uploads the pack's results in a smaller set.
